name: rainysoft-skills
description: Engine-neutral Agent Skills (agentskills.io) with a thin Claude Code wrapper. Domain-grouped plugins; Codex wrapper to follow.

plugins.name: windows-maintenance
plugins.description: [Windows] Windows & WSL optimization and maintenance skills: compact the WSL2 disk, clean disk space, reduce memory footprint, and remove Store/UWP bloatware. Each asks before changing anything.

plugins.name: linux-maintenance
plugins.description: [Linux] Linux system maintenance skills: reclaim disk space by finding large, old, or unused files and pruning them with per-category confirmation. Reports first and asks before changing anything; never touches WSL, Windows, or network mounts.

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: [Cross-platform] Developer tooling skills: run a fast git-history audit of a repository — churn, bus factor, bug clusters, momentum, firefighting — and present it as a clean README-style report.
